import os
corpus_dir = 'repo-vul/src-vul/boringssl/fuzz/cert_corpus'
files = os.listdir(corpus_dir)
# Find smallest files
sizes = [(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(corpus_dir, f)), f) for f in files]
for size, f in sorted(sizes)[:10]:
    path = os.path.join(corpus_dir, f)
    data = open(path, 'rb').read()
    print(f'File: {f}, size: {size}')
    print(' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[:32]))
    print()
